name: project_state
description: State of the Districts Modeler: project, versions, loaded version, templates, networks, feature counts and whether a job (simulation, sizing, optimization) is running.

name: layers
description: Layers of the QGIS project: name, id, type, feature count, visibility, CRS.

name: features
description: Features of a vector layer: attributes and a geometry summary, optionally filtered with a QGIS expression.

geometry.description: include the geometry as WKT (default false: centroid only)

name: render_map
description: Image (PNG) of the map with the visible layers, of a layer's extent or a given extent.

layer.description: zoom to this layer (name or id)

extent.description: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in the project CRS

name: result_tables
description: Result tables of a version (customers, energy plants, lines, KPIs), the simulated time range, the results basis (full year, representative periods) and whether a job is running (results may be incomplete).

name: result_series
description: Values of a result table: per feature min/max/mean (summary), daily min/max/mean (day) or the raw time steps (raw, limited). Tables: see result_tables.

name: run_log
description: Errors of the IDA runs of a version (result.json) and the end of the newest runner.log.

name: template_components
description: Components of a customer or energy plant template (IDA .idm): component, type and variables.

name: run_checks
description: Model checks of a version: findings {rule, severity, feature, values with threshold and source, text} for the QGIS model, the IDA templates, the results and the data the cost optimization needs (scope cost_optimization: mapping expressions, costs, pairs, required loads, climate file, pump and energy-use lists). Thresholds can be given (else the documented defaults).

name: workflow_state
description: Workflow steps of a version in order, each done, missing or stale with the reason, its wiki pages and check rules.

name: search_help
description: Search the IDA Districts wiki (XWiki space IDA_Districts): titles, page names, URLs.

name: read_help_page
description: Read a page of the IDA Districts wiki: title, URL and content (xwiki/2.1).

name: version_kpis
description: Key figures of a version, the same as in the network report: heat delivered, peak load, length, linear heat density, losses, pump energy, energy and costs per plant and carrier, NPV, NPV per MWh delivered, results basis.

name: compare_versions
description: Key figures of two versions and their differences (b - a), with a note when the results bases differ.
